description: Domaine Collotte's 2015 Bourgogne Blanc is a fresh, unadorned Chardonnay shaped by orchard fruit, citrus, and chalk. Stainless-steel aging preserves clarity and gives the palate a clean, direct line.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2015 Domaine Collotte Bourgogne Blanc Chardonnay.
sommelierNotes: Serve at 10-12°C with shellfish, grilled river fish, or a young goat cheese.
